faq.question: Is MBBS in Bangladesh safe for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, Bangladesh is generally considered very safe for Indian students. Hostels offer 24/7 security, CCTV monitoring, and dedicated female and male resident facilities with familiar Indian food.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Bangladesh recognized in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees from BMDC-recognized colleges are fully valid in India as per NMC guidelines. Indian students must qualify NExT/FMGE to practice in India.

faq.question: Is NEET required for MBBS admission in Bangladesh?
faq.answer: Yes, qualifying NEET is mandatory for all Indian students pursuing MBBS abroad as per NMC regulations.

faq.question: What is the total cost of MBBS in Bangladesh?
faq.answer: The complete package (tuition + hostel + food) usually ranges from ₹25 lakh to ₹45 lakh for the full 6-year course.
